If no epitaxial layer is present, the extension of the distance is now about the only remedy left to reduce coupling. This is not quite true. The third dimension can be used as well. This n-well diffusion with its depletion region acts as an isolator between Injector and Receiver. In this way, the current path from Injector to Receiver is made longer, the resistance larger and the coupling weaker.
